name: Microgrid storage low-energy start-support request
summary: Requests alternate generation or load reduction when the documented storage reserve condition is reached.
description: Requests alternate generation or load reduction when the documented storage reserve condition is reached. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage reserve condition” at the input and “Alternate power support request” at the output. Reserve policy must account for restoration capability.
